claim_text: The estimated birth prevalence of NF1 is 1/2,000 to 1/3,000, compared with 1/46,000 to 1/75,000 for Legius syndrome.
notes: Full text (PMC8354850). Data cited from a primary study (secondary citation in a consensus paper): refs 15, 16. Primary paper should be read directly and may support a higher strength.
source_title: Revised diagnostic criteria for neurofibromatosis type 1 and Legius syndrome: an international consensus recommendation
